desc:
🥚 Welcome to Steal A Slime Egg!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from giant sleeping slimes
🏃 Escape past the red line before they catch you
🐣 Grow and hatch eggs into rare slimes
💰 Place slimes on your plot to earn cash
⚡ Train on your treadmill to gain Speed
🌍 Unlock 7 areas, from Forest to Space
🪤 Use traps and bats to stop other stealers
📖 Collect every slime in the Index!

💎 Premium Players get +10% More Money & Speed!
🎁 Free Lucky Spins and daily rewards
💖 Like the game and join the group for free rewards!
🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players (Console Coming Soon!)

💖Game inspired by steal an egg
